David,

Thanks for the continued partnership — Voltix will be up for renewal on Oct 1. - One-time goodwill credit to offset the spike from May outages (we've flagged ~$38k on the invoice)

- An SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.9% latency for the model family we use (latency SLA) or a meaningful service credit alternative
- Preferably a modest renewal discount for year 1 to reflect committed volume growth

We love the platform but this pricing cliff is real — procurement needs a proposal this week to avoid evaluating other providers. Attached: voltix_invoice_May.pdf and usage_report_Q3.pdf.

Can we set expectations on what concessions Redwood is willing to approve?

Best,

David — quick note from AE perspective. Voltix is strategic in our manufacturing vertical and the usage trend is sticky (they're integrating ML across three new product lines). My recommendation to present to Deal Desk / CRO: 

- Offer a firm package: 18-month term + 12% first-year renewal discount + one-time $25k credit tied to the May incident 
- Add SLA addendum: 99.9% latency SLO for primary model family with a capped service-credit (max 2% of annual spend) 
- Include a usage minimum: commit to 75% of current 3-month trailing usage as guaranteed minimum — if they under-run we true-up at renewal pricing

This reduces our credit outlay, gives Voltix predictability, and creates guardrails. If leadership pushes back we can incrementally increase the credit to $30k, but I want approval before we move beyond that. Please include finance/legal sign-off before sending to Emma.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
